jobs.name: jar-sparkpi
jobs.description: example JAR that ships with Spark, path on the Kyuubi host
jobs.cli: python client/kyuubi_submit.py --url http://localhost:10099 submit /opt/spark/examples/jars/spark-examples_2.13-4.1.3.jar --remote --class org.apache.spark.examples.SparkPi --name jar-sparkpi -- 20
jobs.curl:
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:10099/api/v1/batches \
  -u anji: -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d @- <<'JSON'
{
  "batchType": "SPARK",
  "name": "jar-sparkpi",
  "className": "org.apache.spark.examples.SparkPi",
  "resource": "/opt/spark/examples/jars/spark-examples_2.13-4.1.3.jar",
  "conf": {},
  "args": [
    "20"
  ]
}
JSON
jobs.kyuubi_ctl_yaml:
apiVersion: v1
username: anji
request:
  batchType: SPARK
  name: jar-sparkpi
  resource: /opt/spark/examples/jars/spark-examples_2.13-4.1.3.jar
  className: org.apache.spark.examples.SparkPi
  args:
    - "20"
  configs:
    {}
options:
  verbose: true

  -F 'batchRequest=</tmp/batch-request.json;type=application/json' \
